answer: Beacon spot-checks and heartbeats block bulk fakes. Each agent locks a 100-credit deposit and sends a heartbeat every 30 minutes. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities; a picked agent must answer in 10 minutes or lose deposit and reputation. Like real juniper and violet in a garden, agents answer; painted copies cannot. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 credits plus compute; an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
